run_extract_odinw_results: run the script to aggregate ODinW validation results from a results directory
run_parse_args: run parse_args to configure the argparse CLI with the required res_dir argument
run_main: run main to process val_stats.json files across 13 ODinW dataset subsets and print average bbox AP
review_main: review the main function that iterates over VAL13_SET subsets and extracts coco_eval_bbox_AP metrics
summarize_VAL13_SET: summarize the VAL13_SET constant listing 13 ODinW benchmark dataset names for evaluation
